claims.explanation: NSC-663284 is a quinone-based Cdc25 inhibitor that also redox cycles to generate reactive oxygen species, causing oxidative stress and cell-cycle arrest. Selectivity likely arises from dependence on Cdc25 phosphatases for G1/S and G2/M progression and from sensitivity to oxidative stress, so lines with high CDC25A/B/C expression or low antioxidant capacity are more sensitive, while those with high antioxidant or survival signaling are protected.

features.basis: Direct target; high expression increases dependence on Cdc25A for cell-cycle progression
Direct target; high expression increases dependence on Cdc25B
Direct target; high expression increases dependence on Cdc25C
Activating mutations upregulate antioxidant response, countering drug-induced ROS
Loss-of-function mutations activate NRF2 antioxidant program, reducing oxidative stress
High expression increases thioredoxin reductase activity, enhancing antioxidant capacity
High expression increases heme oxygenase-1, a cytoprotective antioxidant enzyme
High anti-apoptotic BCL2 expression reduces sensitivity to apoptosis
High BCL-xL expression reduces apoptosis sensitivity
Survivin overexpression inhibits apoptosis and may protect from Cdc25 inhibitor-induced death
High cyclin B1 expression indicates reliance on Cdc25 for mitotic entry
High CDK1 expression increases dependence on Cdc25-mediated activation
